reason: A DeepSeek Harness web plugin that adds a customizable rotating quote display above the sidebar settings area, with refresh history, corpus editing, and theme-aware styling.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness WebUI 侧边栏中显示可自定义的名言、诗词或游戏台词，并提供刷新、回退和语料设置功能。
summaries.en: Adds a customizable rotating display of quotations, poetry, or game lines to the DeepSeek Harness WebUI sidebar with refresh, history, and corpus settings.

capabilities: Adds a quote display and settings control to the DeepSeek Harness web sidebar
Reads and serves the local corpus.txt file through a plugin route
Stores plugin settings in browser localStorage
